seo.title: Private Matchmaking Services | HeartLink
seo.description: Compare HeartLink's confidential Private Registry, Success Plan, Premium Search and Private Circle matchmaking services.

hero.title: Four ways to begin. One standard of care.
hero.description: Choose confidential registry consideration, a success-led engagement or a retained private search. Paid services are accepted only when HeartLink believes it can add value.

tiers.label: 01 · Profile submission
tiers.title: Private Registry
tiers.description: Free and entirely private. We do not search on your behalf, but if a retained family is a genuine fit, you will hear from us.
features: Private review by the HeartLink team
Contacted only when there is genuine relevance

tiers.label: 02 · Success based
tiers.title: Success Plan
tiers.description: No upfront registration or advisory fee. HeartLink is paid only when a match succeeds, and accepts this engagement only when there is a credible path to help.

tiers.label: 03 · Active search
tiers.title: Premium Search
tiers.description: A retained search personally directed by Gopi Shah and Alpa Apoorva, with active outreach, private review and selected introductions.
features: Accepted only where HeartLink can add value

tiers.label: 04 · Highest touch
tiers.title: Private Circle
tiers.description: Our most discreet, highest-touch engagement for families who require tighter visibility and direct founder involvement.

protocol.title: Capacity is limited by design.
paragraphs: The Private Registry can grow, but retained searches stay intentionally limited so every family receives real attention.

HeartLink accepts a maximum of 50 active mandates across Premium Search and Private Circle, combined. Acceptance, terms and service level are discussed only after we understand the individual, family and search.

process.title: A discreet path from first conversation to considered introduction.
process.description: Once a search is accepted, it remains private, selective and personally guided from discovery through mutual decision.

steps.label: Step 01
steps.title: Private Discovery
steps.description: We meet the individual and family to understand background, values, preferences, expectations and readiness.

steps.label: Step 02
steps.title: Search & Verification
steps.description: We search within trusted networks and review education, work, family context, identity, intent and references.

steps.label: Step 03
steps.title: Selected Introductions
steps.description: We present only considered possibilities. Identifying details move forward only with permission and genuine interest.

steps.label: Step 04
steps.title: Mutual Conversation
steps.description: When both sides are interested, we help the individuals and families begin a clear, respectful conversation.

steps.label: Step 05
steps.title: Decision & Guidance
steps.description: We support compatibility conversations, family alignment and—when useful—the transition through commitment.

closing.quote: Begin with the family, the person and the search—not a package.
